We support 10,000+ clients in over 150 countries, and that reach gives you the room to grow, learn, and make a real difference. This position is key in handling the tax consequences of global mobility and facilitating a smooth transition for employees across different countries. Your main objective is to reduce tax-related risks and costs while ensuring that both the organization and its employees adhere to relevant tax laws. Accurately prepare, review, and file tax returns and related deliverables for globally mobile employees within designated deadlines. Offer specialized advice and recommendations on tax planning, withholding responsibilities, and social security contributions. Act as the primary point of contact for clients, manage engagement financials (billing, collections, KPIs), and provide timely updates on tax matters. Identify new business opportunities, expand the client portfolio, and develop global mobility tax strategies to minimize liabilities for both companies and employees. Qualifications A Swedish degree in law or economics, preferably with a focus on taxation. Strong interest in international individual taxation, global mobility, and employment-related matters. Excellent communication skills in Swedish and English. Interest in systems and digitalisation. Previous experience in taxation or social security law in the private sector or at a government authority is considered an advantage. Additional Information This is a hybrid role that requires you to be in our Malmö office (Stockholm and Göteborg also available) at least 3 days a week. We are an equal opportunity employer that does not discriminate based on any legally protected status. Please note, AI is used as part of the application process.
